guide.title: How knowledge gets here
guide.intro: The SharpTalk AI agent answers only from what is defined in KB-Documents. Assets you already keep in Notion, Google Drive or files — policies, guides, manuals — come in as a Source, are synced, drafted and reviewed on the Board, and are then adopted as the KB-Documents the agent actually cites.
guide.step1Body: Drive or Notion — connects the assets you already have. A pipe, not knowledge yet.
guide.step2Body: [Sync] on a source row pulls the pipe in. Until it runs, the source contributes nothing.
guide.step3Body: First draft and review. Publish, check with a simulation, then adopt.
guide.step4Body: The only thing an answer is ever grounded in.
guide.jumpHint: Click a step to jump to its section.
guide.noteSource: Shortcuts that skip the board: add a KB-Document directly, sync the catalogue, or import a product CSV — all land in KB-Documents.
guide.noteCategory: A category is both the label and, when you narrow it, which agents may cite it.
guide.noteOptionalGuides: Optional: product usage guides (per product type) are on for this tenant — see the section below Sources.

help.catalogWhat: Turns the products already in your catalogue into one KB-Document each, so answers can quote them.
help.catalogPreview: A preview shows what would be written before anything is.
help.catalogCategory: The brand becomes the category; these categories are read-only and always available to every agent.
help.catalogVariants: Shade and size variants of one product are folded into a single document.
help.catalogRerun: Safe to re-run: products are matched by handle and updated, never duplicated.
help.csvWhat: Makes one KB-Document per row. Use it when the products are not in the catalogue, or the descriptions live elsewhere.
help.csvUpsert: Rows are matched by Handle and updated — re-uploading the same file creates no duplicates.
help.csvPrice: Price is never stored as knowledge: a stale price in an answer is worse than no price.
help.csvCategory: The category comes from Brand, or Category when Brand is absent.
help.addDocWhat: Writes a document by hand — policies, FAQs, anything an agent should be able to quote.
help.addDocOneTopic: One topic per document. Two answers in one document make both harder to retrieve.
help.addDocWords: Use the words customers use, not internal terms — retrieval matches their question against your text.
help.addDocCategory: The category files it, and decides which agents may cite it if you narrow it.
help.addDocPending: A new document is searchable by keyword immediately; semantic search starts once it is indexed.

notionShareHint: The Notion page isn't shared with the integration — open the page in Notion, ⋯ → Connections, and add the integration.
deleteSourceDocsNote: This source's documents are not deleted — they are deactivated and excluded from retrieval. You can re-activate them from the document list.
ingestFileHint: pdf · docx · xlsx · csv · md, up to 15MB. AI segments the content into draft articles.
ingestVideoHint: YouTube videos with public captions only (caption-less videos cannot be analyzed).
ingestTruncated: The source exceeded 200,000 characters; the excess was cut.
ingestReviewHint: Analysis of "{{source}}". Select the drafts to save and polish titles/categories.
